prompt:
TWO images are provided. IMAGE 1 is the EDIT TARGET / CANVAS — two side-by-side columns of identical size, output at 5:4, matching IMAGE 1's layout exactly. IMAGE 2 is a LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY, shown purely to tell you WHERE each control goes — it is NOT part of the canvas you edit and NONE of its colours may ever appear in your output. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO CAPTIONS and NO LABELS anywhere in EITHER column — not under controls, not on the strip, not a title, nothing; the device is wordless, identified by icons and shapes only. IMAGE 1's LEFT column is a neutral grey placeholder body (a rough blob, no colour markings at all) plus a bottom SPRITE-STRIP band that is currently EMPTY/blank. IMAGE 2 shows the SAME placeholder body and the SAME strip band, but with COLOURED SOLID FILLED patches marking each control's EXACT position, size and shape — READ IMAGE 2 to know where each control belongs, then PAINT that control at that exact position/size/shape into IMAGE 1's left column. Each guide colour in IMAGE 2 maps to a control: PURE RED = a PLAY triangle (right-pointing) merged with pause bars; ROSE PINK = a SKIP-BACK double-triangle / rewind chevrons; MAGENTA = a SKIP-FORWARD double-triangle / fast-forward chevrons; ORANGE = a REPEAT loop (two arrows chasing in a circle); YELLOW = a QUEUE / playlist icon (stacked horizontal lines); VIOLET-PURPLE = a VOLUME knob (top face, knurled rim, pointer notch); DEEP PURPLE = the SEEK progress slider thumb (wide low grip); PURE GREEN = a SHUFFLE icon (two crossing arrows); PURE BLUE = a VISUALIZER / spectrum-analyzer display window; RGB(255, 255, 128) = an ALBUM ART / cover display window. COPY THE POSITION, SIZE AND SHAPE of every guide shape from IMAGE 2 exactly (their layout is locked) — but IMAGE 2's COLOURS ARE NEVER PAINTED anywhere in your output; they exist ONLY in IMAGE 2, purely as position markers for you to read, and must not leak, echo, tint or appear in ANY form in IMAGE 1's edited output. The grey body in IMAGE 1 is ONLY a rough placeholder showing roughly where the controls sit — you are FREE and STRONGLY ENCOURAGED to sculpt a BOLD, DISTINCTIVE, ASYMMETRIC, theme-appropriate outer HOUSING around them: an ornate, characterful, sculpted form with a memorable silhouette. Reshape the outer silhouette DRAMATICALLY to suit the theme; ONLY the control positions (as shown by IMAGE 2) stay fixed.
THEME (design the finished device in THIS style — you own all materials, colours, form, lighting): Quintessential FRUTIGER AERO (early-2000s glossy 'aqua' aesthetic): a translucent glossy media-player pod of clear aqua-blue and cyan GLASS with liquid highlights and water-droplet beads, brushed liquid-silver metal bezels, a lush grass-green glowing accent, crisp specular reflections and soft shadows, optimistic and clean. Think Windows-Vista-era glass, Apple-Aqua gel buttons, bubbles and water. Buttons are glossy gel jewels; the body is a smooth organic pebble. Vivid, saturated, dimensional — never flat, never grungy.
Fill BOTH columns of your OUTPUT (matching IMAGE 1's device+strip layout) keeping them pixel-aligned.
LEFT column of your output — the FINISHED, richly 3D, tactile, skeuomorphic media player and its loose parts, in the theme above. CRITICAL for cutout: the BACKDROP around the device and BEHIND every strip part is a FLAT, PERFECTLY UNIFORM near-black charcoal tone (RGB ~18,18,24) — a separate keyed-out backdrop with NO gradient/texture/vignette that strongly contrasts the body; the device must never approach the backdrop tone.
  • The finished device uses ONLY its own theme materials/colours — NONE of the guide colours. ABSOLUTELY NO pure red, NO rose pink, NO magenta, NO orange, NO yellow, NO violet-purple, NO deep purple, NO pure green, NO pure blue, NO rgb(255, 255, 128) anywhere in the LEFT column; the guide colours exist ONLY as position markers (never painted).
  • ZERO RESIDUE (CRITICAL) — no coloured ring, rim, bezel, halo, outline or edge-tint of ANY guide colour may appear around any button, socket, groove or slot. Each finished BUTTON is ONE solid piece of the device's own material with NO coloured ring around it — if a button has a coloured ring, it is WRONG. Likewise the album-art and visualizer windows have NO coloured frame (just a dark recessed glass panel flush in the body), and no socket/groove/slot has any coloured rim.
  • The 5 transport/function BUTTONS (play/pause, previous, next, repeat, queue) are raised, glossy, tactile control facets set into the body, EACH clearly bearing its icon EMBOSSED/engraved in relief: a PLAY triangle (right-pointing) merged with pause bars; a SKIP-BACK double-triangle / rewind chevrons; a SKIP-FORWARD double-triangle / fast-forward chevrons; a REPEAT loop (two arrows chasing in a circle); a QUEUE / playlist icon (stacked horizontal lines). Shape + icon + relief only; no text labels; no coloured rim.
  • BUTTON COLOURS COME FROM THE THEME, NEVER FROM THE GUIDES: a button's guide colour marks its POSITION ONLY — the finished button's material/fill must NOT inherit, echo or be tinted toward its guide colour in ANY way. ALL five buttons are made of the device's OWN theme materials/palette, coloured consistently with each other and the body. If any button's colour visibly matches its guide colour, the output is WRONG.
  • THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RULE — EVERY MOVING-PART CAVITY IS EMPTY. The volume knob socket is a bare round HOLE showing only its dark recessed floor (NO knob, NO cap, NO dome, NO dial, NO pointer). The seek slider groove is an EMPTY DARK RECESSED CHANNEL (NO thumb, NO grip, NO handle, NO fill). The shuffle switch slot is an EMPTY DARK rounded well (NO switch, NO lever, NO toggle installed). The device is photographed BEFORE ASSEMBLY: those parts exist ONLY in the bottom sprite strip. Do NOT colour the empty wells — neutral DARK recesses only. If ANY of the three cavities contains ANY part or any fill colour, the output is WRONG and must be redone.
  • SEEK IS JUST AN EMPTY SLOT — a plain EMPTY recessed horizontal SLOT/CHANNEL only, NOT a functioning slider. Absolutely do NOT bake a slider thumb, grip, knob, handle, bar, fill, track-fill or progress indicator into it; the thumb is a SEPARATE loose part in the strip.
  • The ALBUM-ART window and the VISUALIZER window are BLANK, DARK, EMPTY recessed glass SCREENS — flat unlit dark glass panels only, with NOTHING inside them: NO baked spectrum/equalizer bars, NO album cover or artwork, NO waveform, NO icons, NO text. They are OFF screens.
  • SPRITE STRIP — EXACTLY FOUR finished parts in ONE horizontal row, left→right: volume knob cap, seek slider thumb, shuffle switch OFF, shuffle switch ON — in the device's own materials, no guide colours, on the flat charcoal backdrop.
  • THE SEEK STRIP PART IS THE LOOSE THUMB/GRIP **ONLY** — the small handle piece a finger slides, shown by itself on the backdrop, like a spare part in a parts tray. It is ABSOLUTELY NOT a slot, groove, channel, track, rail or recess, and must NOT be drawn sitting in/on any slot or dark channel.
  • EXACT FIT — each strip part is the EXACT size & shape of its slot (knob cap = socket diameter; thumb fits the groove; each shuffle state exactly fills the switch slot). Do NOT resize a part.
  • SHUFFLE STATES — design a CHARACTERFUL switch that fits the theme (lever, flip-toggle, sliding bolt, rotating latch, gem that shifts, valve, eye that opens — any physical two-state mechanism), as long as BOTH states share the SAME OUTER HOUSING SILHOUETTE at the same size and are CLEARLY MIRROR-OPPOSITE: the moving element sits at ONE end/side in OFF and the OPPOSITE end/side in ON. Put ABSOLUTELY NO 'ON', 'OFF', 'I', 'O' or any text/letters/words/labels on either switch part.
  • CAMERA — render EVERY strip part in a PERFECTLY FLAT, STRAIGHT-DOWN, TOP-DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC view — the camera is directly overhead at exactly 90°, the same view as the device. Each part is drawn as if lying FLAT on a table seen from straight above, with ZERO thickness, height or depth visible. The volume knob cap is a FLAT ROUND DISC / COIN — you see ONLY its circular TOP FACE; you must NOT see any cylindrical SIDE WALL, edge, height or 3D body. ABSOLUTELY NO product-shot angle, NO 3/4 view, NO tilt, NO isometric, NO perspective, NO visible sides.
RIGHT column of your output — a precise REGION MASK on pure BLACK, pixel-aligned to your LEFT column. For EACH control paint ONE SOLID FILLED blob in ITS OWN guide colour (as shown in IMAGE 2), at the EXACT same position, size and silhouette as that control on your LEFT column (the seek-slider blob is a FULL-HEIGHT horizontal bar matching the groove, NOT a thin line; the shuffle blob is a tall portrait rounded-rectangle; each knob/button blob a solid disc): PURE RED region filled 255,0,0; ROSE PINK region filled 255,0,128; MAGENTA region filled 255,0,255; ORANGE region filled 255,128,0; YELLOW region filled 255,255,0; VIOLET-PURPLE region filled 128,0,255; DEEP PURPLE region filled 128,0,128; PURE GREEN region filled 0,255,0; PURE BLUE region filled 0,0,255; RGB(255, 255, 128) region filled 255,255,128. DISPLAY-WINDOW BLOBS — the visualizer and album-art blobs must EXACTLY cover their painted window's GLASS area on your LEFT column: the SAME rectangle at the SAME position with the SAME rounded corners, edge-to-edge with the glass.; and each STRIP PART as a solid COMPACT blob of its colour (volume cap=violet-purple, seek thumb=deep purple, BOTH shuffle states=pure green) exactly matching its part's silhouette & position in your LEFT strip. CRITICAL: each blob is TIGHT to its shape — NEVER let a colour bleed or stretch across the strip band or flood a rectangle; the 4 strip blobs are 4 separate compact shapes with black gaps between them. Every blob is ONE solid filled silhouette, no outlines, no holes. Everything else is pure black.
